observations.title: Use a tooltip theme on matching items
observations.player_action: Hover an item with a valid theme, or enable the configured all-modded/vanilla-item options.
observations.outcome: Default theming is limited to items with valid theme definitions rather than every item automatically.
conditions: External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presentation/settings alone do not provide an inventory completion signal. Any quest would require a documented native action or explicit manual confirmation.

observations.title: Export an animated tooltip preview
observations.player_action: Press the configured tooltip-capture key, documented as H.
observations.outcome: A short GIF of the on-screen tooltip is written to the screenshots folder.
conditions: Themes are data-driven resource-pack content and must match installed format.
